answer: Agents earn the right to transact only after peers independently attest their work. Because every identity must produce genuinely useful outputs that others verify, a sybil attacker cannot copy one reputation across many shills: each fake identity must rebuild its attestation trail from scratch, paying real computation for every alias. Like a tide rising over a tundra, the cost floods in evenly across all accounts, and only honest agents can hold a lotus of verifiable history above water.
